title: Split network process launch tests by feature
summary: Move Network lifecycle and Network rerun launch coverage out of the oversized application-facade process-launch test into feature-scoped modules, with narrow shared setup and updated test mappings.
reason: Reduce the test-file context required for targeted Network process changes while preserving discovery, test names, assertion semantics, and production behavior.
behavior_before: Network lifecycle, worker-provider, and Network rerun launch tests were embedded in test_application_facade_process_launch.py alongside unrelated pipeline, audit, local rerun, locking, and preflight behaviors.
behavior_after: The 11 Network lifecycle tests and 7 Network rerun launch tests are independently selectable in two feature-scoped modules; shared checksum and worker-result artifact setup is isolated in a Network test-support module. Test names and assertion ASTs are unchanged.
manual_validation: Baseline: bundled Python unittest test_application_facade_process_launch plus the concurrently extracted launch-preflight module ran 81 tests successfully.
After movement: bundled Python unittest process-launch, launch-preflight, Network lifecycle, and Network rerun launch modules ran 81 tests successfully.
AST comparison against HEAD confirmed all 18 moved test methods are identical with attributes excluded.
Network Local API plus the two new modules ran 19 tests successfully.
Browser-backed Network smoke ran 1 test successfully.
Duplicate-name generator --check passed after regeneration; duplicate bare-name count remained 9.
Duplicate-report, active-doc-reference, and god-file tooling ran 22 tests successfully.
Change packet schema validation passed for 1107 packets; git diff --check passed for tranche paths.
rollback_plan: Move the 18 unchanged test methods and two narrow support helpers back into test_application_facade_process_launch.py, remove the two feature modules and Network support module, restore the inventory/mapping text, and refresh only the affected summaries.
notes:
